A nucleosome consists of 146–147 base pairs of DNA wrapped around a histone octamer core.  
The description matches this definition exactly: a subunit of DNA and protein, with ~134–147 bp DNA around a protein octamer.  
Histone (A) refers only to the protein component.  
Chromatin (B) is the general DNA-protein complex.  
Solenoid (D) is a higher-order coiling of nucleosomes.  

Final answer: (C)
